summary.text: Jon Burns, a Republican, is the 75th Speaker of the Georgia House of Representatives and represents House District 159; he was first elected to the House in 2004 and became Speaker in 2023.

paragraphs.text: He was House Majority Leader from 2015 until his nomination as Speaker.

According to his official biography, Burns was born and raised in Effingham County, earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Georgia Southern College and a Juris Doctor from John Marshall Law School, and lives on the family farm in northern Effingham County.
